open_reason: Managed semantics are qualified for Local, Pandas, and Polars native paths and for the incremental cursor publication barrier. SQL, PySpark, DataFusion, DuckDB portable compilation, dynamic graph expansion, and continuous Spark streaming remain unavailable in the managed path and fail closed with concrete capability or runtime-owner reasons.
